items.action: Write the MirrorMaker 2 configuration with two one-way flows: redpanda->kafka for tenant.tenant.events only (with checkpoints and group offset sync for the groups ecommerce-catalog-service and ecommerce-image-service), and kafka->redpanda for the three catalog.* topics only (no checkpoints, no offset syncs). IdentityReplicationPolicy keeps topic names; heartbeats, ACL sync and topic-config sync are off; all replication factors are 1.

implementation_justification.note: Catalog consumes only tenant.tenant.events, group ecommerce-catalog-service, offset reset earliest.

implementation_justification.note: tenant.tenant.events is produced by the tenant service, which stays on Redpanda.

implementation_justification.reference: IdentityReplicationPolicy cannot detect cycles, so the two allow-lists are disjoint and heartbeats are off; no topic is mirrored in both directions.
Checkpoints filter by the flow's topic list, so offsets of ecommerce-image-service on catalog.product.events are not copied to Kafka; only tenant.tenant.events offsets are translated.
